observed: Wiring gate failed: max 32.319 mm; runtime-owner and baked-owner errors identical; frame 1 max 0.83 um; driver difference exactly 1/60 at every non-rest sample; only right-arm chain meshes affected.
cause: Harness assumed frame f at (f-1)/fps. The exported clip keys frame f at f/fps (accessor min 1/60 s, max 61/60 s, 61 keys, LINEAR), so every sample was posed one frame early.
evidence: GLB animation input accessor min/max read directly; exporter option export_anim_slide_to_zero left at default.
known_wrong_label: blender-reference.json fields time_s and frame_to_time use (frame-1)/fps; they are labels only, never read by the harness, and are left as written.
fix: p1.js maps frame -> frame/fps and refuses to run if the clip key times do not match that rule.
attempt_1_negative_controls: Not meaningful: the baseline comparison itself was failing.
contract_finding: Game-facing clips need an explicit time-origin rule (slide to zero or documented lead-in), otherwise loops carry a 1/fps hold at the start.
